title: Sales And Marketing Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities: - Generate leads and convert sales for Ashok Leyland vehicles. - Field visits & customer follow-ups. - Build and maintain customer relationships. - Achieve monthly sales targets. 
 Desired Candidate Profile: - Any Graduate / 12th Pass with good communication skills. - Must have a two-wheeler and willingness for field work. - Good negotiation and interpersonal skills. - Local candidates preferred. - Experienced candidates from Automobile / Commercial Vehicle sales will be given preference. 
 Salary & Benefits: - Salary: Rs. 15,000 + Rs. 2,500 TA + Attractive Incentives (Best as per experience) - Growth opportunity in automobile sales

Key Skills: Lead generation,Presentable,Sales,Sales,Marketing,Field marketing,Field,Generation
